City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  April 29, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:35 a.m.

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Ken Campos, City Attorney
  Maria E. Heaney, Revenue Manager

  Staff Present:  Angela Williams, Public Works Department
  Ericka Cabanillas, ITC Department

1. The minutes of April 15, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. The Guy Black Show Live - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the
  recommended settlement payment of $4,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Neopost - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended settlement
  payment of $3,205.00. Motion carried unanimously.

4. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:50 a.m.

Adjournment
